title: Inmac Wstore reports a cyberattack that disrupted its website, orders and deliveries
date_note: FrenchBreaches (25 November) says the attack was detected on Tuesday 24 November.
geo_basis: The article calls Inmac Wstore a French supplier and names no city.
summary: FrenchBreaches and Silicon.fr report, citing Inmac Wstore's communiqué, that the IT supplier detected a cyberattack on 24 November, isolated part of its systems, contacted the authorities and filed a complaint. Its website is temporarily down and orders and deliveries are disrupted. Silicon.fr says nothing yet shows ransomware and no data leak is confirmed; no restoration date has been given.
plain: Inmac Wstore says it was hit by a cyberattack. Its website is down and orders and deliveries are delayed. It says nothing currently shows a data leak.
exec: A French IT supplier's website and order handling are disrupted by a cyberattack, per its communiqué.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Inmac Wstore says it will contact customers whose orders are affected.

validation.note: FrenchBreaches and Silicon.fr both relay Inmac Wstore's communiqué (Silicon.fr cites FrenchBreaches); Inmac's own page not read, so kept single_source.

review.note: validation: state was disputed with no conflicting source; now single_source, tier aggregator (sole source is a breach-alert site). Facts match FrenchBreaches page
